extracted.intended_audience: NLP/AI researchers and practitioners working on long-form story generation with large language models
extracted.subtask_description: Designing and evaluating a multi-agent framework (outline, planning, writing agents) to generate coherent, interwoven, long-form stories using LLMs and producing a dataset of long stories for model training and evaluation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Discourse coherence
rubrics_metrics.description: Discourse coherence, which requires plot consistency, logical coherence, and completeness in the long-form generation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure long-form outputs maintain consistent plots, logical progression, and completeness across many chapters/segments; the paper proposes a writing agent that dynamically compresses story history to help maintain coherence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Narrative complexity
rubrics_metrics.description: Narrative complexity, which requires an interwoven and engaging narrative.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Produce interwoven, engaging narratives with multiple interacting events/threads; the planning agent is used to detail events and plan which events appear in each chapter to maintain this interwoven structure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Outline quality (event-based outlines)
rubrics_metrics.description: Outline agent, which generates event-based outlines containing rich event plots, character, and event-event relationships.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Outlines should be event-centered and richly specify plots, characters, and relationships between events to provide structure for downstream planning and writing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter-level planning
rubrics_metrics.description: Planning agent, which further details events and plans which events should be written in each chapter to maintain an interwoven and engaging story.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Plan distribution of events across chapters explicitly to preserve narrative interweaving and pacing; use the planner to decide what to write per chapter rather than relying solely on token-level generation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dynamic history compression / context management
rubrics_metrics.description: Writing agent, which dynamically compresses the story history based on the current event to generate and reflect new plots, ensuring the coherence of the generated story.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Manage long-context information by compressing past story content relative to the current event so the model can produce new, coherent plot developments without losing important history.

rubrics_metrics.name: Evaluation: human and automated assessment
rubrics_metrics.description: We conduct both human and automated evaluation, and StoryWriter significantly outperforms existing story generation baselines in both story quality and length.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate generated stories using a combination of human judgments (for quality, engagement, coherence) and automated metrics (e.g., length, possibly automated coherence/consistency measures); compare against baselines to demonstrate improvement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Story length as a quality/scale metric
rubrics_metrics.description: StoryWriter is used to generate a dataset containing about 6,000 high-quality long stories, with an average length of 8,000 words.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consider absolute story length (e.g., thousands of words) as an axis of evaluation and dataset construction; longer outputs should still meet coherence and narrative-complexity requirements.
